text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. Tokai Teio, 
the admired senior of her fellow 
classmates, will be competing as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the Grand Prix fit to crown this year's 
strongest, would Sweep Tosho be able to 
show them her magic once more?
